body_html:
I think I am officially going to walk away from Wordpress. I just can't take it anymore. Might be a Wordpress update. Might be a plug-in update. Might be the position of Saturn in relation to Jupiter.

I am going through plug ins one by one and turning them off all the time to diagnose problems. Ain't no way to live

......but then the daunting task of exporting and importing all that content into a new blog platform or moving some to webpages.

Designing my new static home page.

Three months from now I am probably still on Wordpress
